Billing questions

How does billing work?
Billing is charged at the beginning of each monthly or annual cycle, and you can cancel anytime.
Is my data secure?
Data is encrypted at rest and in transit using industry-standard protocols.
What integrations do you support?
Connect popular tools or build custom integrations with our API.

Subscription & Billing

Common questions about plans, payments, and cancellations.

What subscription plans do you offer?
Choose Starter, Professional, or Enterprise based on storage, API, and support needs.
How does billing work?
Billing occurs automatically at the start of each cycle.
How do I cancel my subscription?
Cancel from account settings with access through the current billing period.
